Type: milk jug stoneware vase
Use: holding flowers or stems; living room, dining room, bedroom, on a table or shelf
Style: farmhouse, rustic
Materials: crackle-glazed stoneware, unglazed clay base
Colors: cream, warm tan clay
Shape: short wide cylinder, rounded shoulder, short wide neck, chipped glaze edge, compact
Feel: earthy, worn, cozy
Goes with: natural wood, linen, greenery, warm neutrals; farmhouse or rustic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Farmhouse Milk Jug Stoneware Home Decor Flower Vase - 6.25 x 5.75 Inches, Cream and Clay
product.description: At first glance it looks like an antique milk jug, but it's actually a stoneware piece sized to hold a small houseplant or freshly cut flowers. The earth-tone clay of the base also shows through the milky white glazing on the upper portion. 5.75" Diameter x 6.25" H Can serve as a vase for fresh cut flowers or as a small planter 100% stoneware Does not have drainage holes
